name: Panasonic TM/TL Series (GIII) Arc Welding Robot

name: Panasonic G4 Series – Arc Welding Robot (Separate Welding Power Source)
desc:
• Designed for flexible integration with an external welding power source (separated type) for optimized system configuration.
  • Advanced welding control optimization tailored to robot posture for reduced cycle times and improved productivity.
  • Improved spatter reduction through modern welding methods, contributing to higher-quality welds and less cleanup.
  • Intuitive teach pendant with touch panel, making operation and programming easier and more efficient.
  • Eliminates the need for an external step-down transformer at many international sites, simplifying setup and installation.
  • OPC UA compatibility enables seamless integration with peripheral devices and industrial networks for connected workflows.
  • Enhances robot motion performance with faster axis speeds and more accurate control for smoother, efficient welding cycles.
  • High-resolution touch interface and 3D display, improving visibility and ease of programming even with gloves on.
  • Open communication standards and connectivity features support integration with sensors, data systems, and automation infrastructure.

name: Panasonic TAWERS WG4 – Arc Welding Robot (Welding Power Source Integrated Type)
desc:
• Integrated Welding Power Source (TAWERS): Robot controller and welding power source are fully integrated for seamless control and high-speed data communication, eliminating interface delays and improving welding consistency.
  • Low Spatter Welding: MTS-CO₂ welding method as standard significantly reduces spatter for cleaner welds and less post-weld cleanup.
  • Advanced Welding Processes: Supports CO₂, MAG, MIG and stainless-steel welding applications with precision and reliability.
  • Enhanced Productivity: Optimized control according to robot posture helps shorten cycle times and boost throughput.
  • Intuitive Touch Panel Teach Pendant: High-resolution touch interface and 3D display make programming and operation more user-friendly—even with gloves on.
  • Improved Motion and Control: Faster axis movement and improved motion accuracy help deliver smoother, more efficient welding cycles.
  • Compact, Space-Saving Design: Cables and components arranged to minimize footprint without sacrificing performance.
  • Industry Standard Connectivity: Conformance with OPC UA facilitates integration with peripheral devices and supports smart factory workflows.
  • Functional Safety: Designed to comply with international safety standards, with software-based safety mechanisms for flexible, safer operation.
image: assets/brands items/panasonic/Arc Welding Robot/Panasonic TAWERS WG4 Welding Robot.jpg

name: Panasonic Active TAWERS 4 (AWP4) - Arc Welding Robot
desc:
• AWP4 (Active Wire Process 4) compatibility: Works seamlessly with TAWERS (WG4) to achieve ultra-low spatter and stable arc control during welding.
  • Ultra-low spatter welding: High-precision wire feeding and advanced waveform control dramatically reduce spatter—by up to ~98 % in CO₂ welding compared to conventional methods—resulting in cleaner welds and less post-weld cleanup.
  • High-speed welding capability: Optimized arc response enables faster welding speeds without compromising weld quality.
  • Integrated power source control (TAWERS): Direct communication between robot controller and welding power source ensures precise, real-time control for consistent results.
  • Improved bead quality: Enhanced molten puddle stability produces a flatter, higher-quality weld bead surface across a wide range of materials.
  • Supports multiple shielding gases: Works with CO₂, MAG, and MIG gases, making it versatile for various welding applications.
  • High-duty-cycle capability: The air-cooling torch mechanism enables heavy-duty production with an 80 % duty cycle at 310 A output (CO₂ welding), supporting long, continuous operations.
  • Boosts productivity: By reducing spatter and improving weld quality, AWP4 minimizes rework and enhances overall production efficiency.
  • Suitable for mass-production environments: Ideal for automotive and industrial applications requiring high efficiency and repeatable welding quality.
